entries.caption: Sarah arrives in Irún to begin her 40-day Camino del Norte. From Irún she'll follow the coast of the Cantabrian Sea west through Basque country, across Cantabria and Asturias, then turn inland through Galicia to reach Santiago — about 513 miles (825 km).
Just got settled into hostel. Going to shower and then FOOD!!
Have I told you how insane the hydrangeas are here?!? There's sooo many. They're so big. I've seen color variations I've never seen before. They're in full bloom. It's incredible.
We made it to a bar for the World Cup, saw Spain score so the girls decided we're going to the beach. The water here is amazing! Just got back from swimming in the ocean!
Today was literally HELL!! It was SO HARD! SO HOT! And limited shade. 15+ miles. At least the views were pretty for a while!

The trail is like every hike I've ever done all rolled into one. Some parts look like Louisiana, Alabama, or Arkansas, others like Utah and Arizona, and then definitely Hawaii -- and even threw in some Peruvian Incan stairs!
